description:

Military training â€” one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars â€” left him with skills and night terrors in equal measure. He works as a tech retriever out of Burnside Corridor, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Ewout Faalele has built a reputation on reliability rather than flash â€” he shows up, he delivers, he collects.

example_lines: "Corporate R&D security is built to stop amateurs. I'm a professional."
"The prototype is worth more than both our lives combined. Handle it carefully."

story_hooks: A crew member from Cem Ivanov-Appiah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A dead drop Cem Ivanov-Appiah maintains is found and cleaned out â€” whoever did it now has leverage

narrative_function: Cem Ivanov-Appiah is a pressure point â€” the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When he makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of his stories.

daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity â€” mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions

2. Reposition â€” move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten â€” make consequences clear without committing to them
4. Non-lethal force â€” incapacitate, restrain, disable

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation â€” checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm â€” has never fired it
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything â€” late once, nearly died, never again
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Losing their primary augmentation â€” the one that defines their professional identity
